executiveSummary.headline: Protect a Strong Luxury Position With One Coherent, Accurate Story
executiveSummary.lead: Castillo Hotel Son Vida records 50.0% consideration and 62.1% scenario presence, ranking first among four Bonvoy peers. The measured position is credible but not universal. Management’s highest-value work is to resolve the spa-size conflict and make the adults-only Luxury Collection castle, Arabella golf, wellness, events, and wedding offer read as one precise luxury proposition.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared; Certified Peer Position compares only the certified four-hotel set. Presence does not equal bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: The Spa Measurement Requires Hotel Confirmation
themes.what: The same Marriott overview describes the spa as both 900 and 990 square metres, apparently referring to the same facility.
themes.whyItMatters: The conflict is verified, but the correct figure is not. Spa operations must confirm scope and measurement before Marriott corrects the page; the audit should not invent a winner.

themes.title: Distinctive Luxury Attributes Need One Narrative
themes.what: Official content combines an adults-only Luxury Collection castle, Arabella golf access, wellness, meetings, and weddings.
themes.whyItMatters: A signed fact architecture can connect these strengths while distinguishing on-property, affiliated, seasonal, and policy-dependent elements—giving leisure guests and international planners a coherent luxury offer without overstating access or ownership.

themes.title: Narrow Signals Deserve Proportionate Review
themes.what: A Marriott access probe returned an Akamai 403 pattern, and Hotel Saratoga displaced Castillo in only three monitored scenarios.
themes.whyItMatters: Neither observation establishes a broad weakness. Platform support should investigate access, while commercial leadership can review the three scenarios lightly and close them if they are not strategically relevant.

priorities.action: Spa operations and Marriott content: reconcile 900 versus 990 m²
Commercial team: align castle, adults-only, golf, wellness, and events facts
Marriott platform support: investigate bounded access behavior
Commercial team: review only three Saratoga scenarios

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The spa has one hotel-approved measurement or clearly labeled scopes, the luxury proposition is consistent across official pages, and narrow technical and competitive reviews have documented outcomes.
executiveSummary.closing: Castillo Hotel Son Vida can strengthen a credible measured position through precision, not volume: resolve the 900/990 m² spa discrepancy, connect the adults-only castle, golf, wellness, and events offer, and keep the three Hotel Saratoga scenarios in proportion.

actions.headline: Correct the Conflicting Spa Size on the Marriott Overview
actions.priorityWhy: The same official page gives two different measurements for one core luxury amenity.
actions.whatWeFound: The same Marriott overview describes the spa as 900 square metres in one section and 990 square metres in another; both appear to refer to the same facility.
actions.whyItMatters: The conflict is verified, but the correct figure is not. Spa operations must confirm measurement scope before correction; the audit must not infer which number wins.
recommendedSteps: Spa operations confirms the measured and approved figure.
Marriott content support identifies every occurrence and structured field.
Replace the incorrect value and align units and formatting.
actions.supportingParties: Marriott digital content team; hotel marketing
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Confirmation in 1 week; correction within 2–3 weeks
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: Written spa-operations confirmation establishes the approved area and measurement convention.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: A Marriott content ticket identifies both conflicting page locations and the approved replacement.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Every overview occurrence and relevant structured field shows the same approved spa size.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid only if the hotel documents that the figures describe different areas and the page is revised to label those scopes clearly.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Spa operations must confirm the correct measurement and whether any figures use different scopes.

actions.headline: Investigate Marriott Property-Page Access for Intended Crawlers
actions.priorityWhy: A bounded automated GET received an Akamai 403 after redirect, while robots.txt was available.
actions.whatWeFound: Marriott robots.txt returned 200 and did not disallow the property overview path; the automated GET redirected to default.mi and returned 403, while HEAD returned 200.
actions.whyItMatters: Marriott should verify intended behavior before any platform change. The probe does not establish a public outage or universal crawler block.
recommendedSteps: Open a Marriott/Akamai ticket with the redirect chain.
Retest overview and events pages from agreed clients and regions.
Document expected behavior or approved remediation.
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: The platform ticket documents robots policy, redirect chain, status behavior, client, and region.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: If a mismatch is confirmed, Marriott submits a narrow approved platform change.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Agreed clients retest the overview and events pages with results recorded.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if Marriott confirms expected behavior and intended crawlers receive content; rationale is filed.

claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — hotel leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital or brand teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying booking or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked in a later review. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, or revenue.
